events.title: Write My Talking Sale Pitch
must_haves: The talking presenter remains recognizably the grey-haired man in the attached photo.
An audible, coherent, agent-written English line invites viewers to check out the sale.
The speech contains no invented discount, sale date, product, or other specific offer claim.
The man's mouth visibly moves in sync with the spoken line.
The result is one square, 8-second video with a friendly male voice and no captions.

answer_sheet.Source person: Me, the grey-haired man in portrait-man.jpg.
answer_sheet.Sale details: Mention our sale generally; do not invent discounts, dates or products.

events.text: Could you make this pic of me into a talking video where I say something about our sale? I always overthink these little sale messages, so I’d really appreciate having you handle the wording. You can write the line yourself, and somewhere in all of that I need it to be an 8-second square video with a friendly male English voice. Keep the message upbeat and mention our sale generally, without inventing any discounts, dates or products. I’m just hoping it feels welcoming rather than like I’m making a big fuss about it. Please don’t include any captions.
